entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE character portrait for Aleria, vertical 2:3, 1024x1536. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung. Subject: Gwrgan, approximately 43-year-old human seafarer returned after twenty years of captivity. Strong broad working build, mature weatherbeaten handsome face, tired BLUE eyes, scars across brow and cheek, healed scars visible on hands. He has been freshly shaved and decently clothed by his rescuer, NOT a ragged beggar. Very long brown hair extending past the shoulders: DARK BROWN at the roots and upper lengths, progressively fading naturally to LIGHT BROWN toward the long ends. Upper/back portions are tied together with a plain functional cord in a loose practical partial ponytail; remaining long hair stays down. Do not make him blond, white-haired, or gray-haired. Clean simple good wool shirt in muted slate blue, plain brown waistcoat and leather belt, no armour, no fancy uniform, no hat, no jewelry. His arms are demonstratively CROSSED over his chest; both forearms and hands naturally composed. Stubborn proud guarded expression with restrained hurt and exhaustion, not villainous, not smiling. Portrait framed from head to mid-thigh, entire hair and crossed forearms visible, natural human ears. Background: quiet softly simplified timber quay and one indistinct moored merchant ship at Gwynthor harbour in cool daylight; restful composition, few objects. No words, heraldic badges, labels, watermark or border.

Clearly a mature attractive 38-year-old man, intelligent expressive face and confident professional gaze, composed and courteous, not scheming or evil. Elegant Latin-Italian late-medieval fantasy civilian clothing: beautifully tailored dark wine doublet, cream shirt, dark navy short mantle, restrained fine gold edging and discreet clasp, high-quality rich fabric, no hat, no armour, no modern suit or necktie.
